description.value:
Trigger You miss a target with a ranged Strike beyond your first range increment.

Duration until the end of the encounter

The first bullet is a question. The second one is not.

Note where it went. For the rest of the encounter, your ranged Strikes against that specific target reduce the range penalty by 1 for each increment beyond the first, to a minimum of 0. This applies to one target at a time; ranging a new target ends it on the previous one.

cinderfall.incomplete: a per-target persistent tracked state ("this specific target has been ranged") with no companion Effect item in this corpus to carry a flag the way covering-fire-effect/etc. do for their parents; matches the Binding Chain precedent's "no companion record exists" reasoning directly. This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This is a cross-creature effect: it changes a DIFFERENT creature's own roll, HP, condition, healing, or item from the actor's own passive or activated ability, with no companion linked Effect item in this corpus to carry it (unlike the six real *-effect cards this class does have). No selector exists for this anywhere in pf2e-source.
